The composition uses geometric vein structures that twist and intersect in three-dimensional space, while thousands of tiny glowing particles float slowly through the darkness, creating an atmosphere of otherworldly mineral growth and inner light. The scene is both scientifically inspired and dreamlike, evoking the feeling of exploring deep geological formations where light emanates from within the rock itself.
